8. I hereby, promise to abide by the admissible rules and regulations concerning discipline, attendance etc. of

                                                          EXECUTIVE ORDER

               Sub: Scheme for Fee Waiver of admission fees, tuition fees etc. for students taking admission in H.S.,
               BA/BSc/BCom and M.A./M.Sc./M.Com. Courses for the Academic Session 2026–27.

               In continuation of the Fee Waiver Scheme under Pragyan Bharati for free admission in H.S.,
               BA/BSc/BCom and M.A./M.Sc./M.Com. Courses under the Higher Education Department, Government
               of Assam, the scheme shall continue for the Academic Session 2026–27 for eligible students whose parental
               annual income is below Rs. 4.00 lakh from all sources.

               Aim:

               To provide access to higher education to economically disadvantaged students of the State and to support
               them in pursuing higher education without financial hardship.

               1. Scope-

                   i.   The Scheme shall be applicable to eligible students seeking admission into the 1st year of H.S.,
                        B.A., B.Sc., B.Com. and M.A., M.Sc., M.Com. courses during the Academic Session 2026–27.
                  ii.   Students taking admission in any professional, vocational and self-financing course shall not be
                        eligible under this scheme unless otherwise instructed by Government.
                 iii.   In case of H.S., B.A./B.Sc./B.Com. and M.A./M.Sc./M.Com. courses, students whose fees were
                        waived earlier shall also be eligible to avail the benefit of the scheme for subsequent year/semester
                        admissions, subject to fulfilment of eligibility criteria and production of required documents.
                 iv.    Further, students enrolled in continuing semesters who could not submit valid income certificate at
                        the time of entry-level admission but possess valid income certificate at the time of
                        renewal/admission in the concerned semester may also be considered for the Fee Waiver Scheme,
                        subject to due verification by the concerned Higher Educational Institution.

               2. Institutes Incorporated under the Scheme

               The Scheme shall be applicable to:

                   i.   All State Universities, Government Colleges, Autonomous Colleges, Government Model Colleges,
                        Government Model Women Colleges, Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya Adarsha Mahavidyalayas and
                        Provincialised Colleges of Assam.
                  ii.   The Scheme shall not cover Private Colleges, Private Universities and Central Universities situated
                        in Assam.

               3. Applicability

               The following categories of students shall be eligible under the Scheme:

                   i.   Students whose parental annual income is less than Rs. 4.00 lakh from all sources.
                  ii.   Students whose parents, either father or mother, are not employees of the State Government,
                        Central Government, Semi-Government organisations, State Government undertakings or Central
                        Government undertakings. However, provided that, where either or both parent of the student is
                        employed as Grade-IV/MTS post under the State Government, Central Government, Semi-
                        Government organisation, State Government undertaking or Central Government undertaking, the
                        student may be considered eligible for the Fee Waiver Scheme, subject to fulfilment of all other
                        prescribed eligibility conditions.
                 iii.   The student must be a permanent resident of Assam and must possess domicile of Assam in order
                        to avail benefit under the Fee Waiver Scheme. The concerned Higher Educational Institution shall
                        verify the residential/domicile status of the student through valid supporting documents as may be
                        prescribed or notified by the Government.
                 iv.    To avail free admissions in the subsequent years, the attendance of the respective student should
                        not be less than 70% in the academic year.
                  v.    Students who have arrears/backlogs in the previous academic year shall not be eligible to avail the
                        Fee Waiver Scheme. Further, students who have not enrolled for the final examinations of the
                        previous academic year shall also not be eligible to avail of the Fee Waiver Scheme.

                 vi.    Fee waiver will be revoked if any beneficiary student indulges in vandalism, ragging, misconduct,
                        and anti-social activities, which may affect the academic atmosphere of the HEIs.

               4. Proof of Income / Documents Required

                   i.   Ration Card issued by the competent authority shall be treated as the primary proof of income. The
                        Ration Card must be issued by the competent authority of the State of Assam. Ration Cards issued
                        by any other State shall not be accepted for claiming benefit under the Fee Waiver Scheme.
                  ii.   If the Ration Card is not available, only then will an income certificate issued by the concerned
                        Revenue Circle Officer shall be accepted.
                 iii.   Applicants must possess a valid Aadhaar number and this information must be submitted along
                        with a signed consent to the institution.
                 iv.    The College/University authority may grant admission to the student without examining the
                        original marksheet at the time of admission. However, the admitted student must produce the
                        original marksheet within the stipulated time, failing which the admission shall be liable to be
                        cancelled.
                  v.    A declaration shall be obtained from the student stating that neither parent, father or mother, is an
                        employee of the State Government, Central Government, Semi-Government organisation, State
                        Government undertaking or Central Government undertaking. Such declaration form shall be
                        devised by the concerned Registrar/Principal. If such declaration is found to be false, the admission
                        under the Fee Waiver Scheme shall be cancelled and the admission fee shall be realised from the
                        student.
                 vi.    If, however, either or both parents of a student are employed as Grade IV/Multi-Tasking Staff
                        (MTS) under the State Government, Central Government, Semi-Government organisation, State
                        Government undertaking or Central Government undertaking and fulfil the eligibility criteria
                        prescribed above, the student shall submit a declaration in the prescribed format to that effect. Such
                        declaration form shall be devised by the concerned Registrar/Principal.
                vii.    The concerned Higher Educational Institution shall verify the authenticity of the documents
                        submitted by the student before granting benefit under the Scheme.

               5. Power of Admission Committees

                   i.   The Admission Committee of the concerned College or University shall have the power to enquire
                        into the income status of the family in case of doubt regarding the claim of any student. If the
                        Committee is of the view that the income of the parents exceeds Rs. 4.00 lakh per annum, it may
                        recommend cancellation of the benefit under the Fee Waiver Scheme, notwithstanding the
                        documents submitted by the student.
                  ii.   Such enquiry may be initiated suo motu by the Institution or on the basis of any complaint received
                        against any student availing benefit under the Scheme.
                 iii.   Each Institution covered under the Scheme shall constitute an Admission Committee comprising
                        senior faculty members of the Institution. The Principal/Registrar of the Higher Educational
                        Institution shall exercise due diligence and shall ensure that no undeserving candidate is allowed
                        to avail the benefit.
                 iv.    The Admission Committee shall have the discretion to check and verify the Ration Card, income
                        certificate and other documents produced by applicants at the time of admission or renewal
                        admission. In case of any doubt, the Institution may ask the candidate to produce further relevant
                        documents to ascertain the validity of the claim.
                  v.    Only after being fully satisfied with the authenticity of the claim shall the Institution grant
                        admission under the Fee Waiver category. If the Institution is not satisfied with the claim, the
                        applicant shall be informed in writing with justification and admission may be granted under the
                        non-fee waiver category, subject to fulfilment of other admission norms.
                 vi.    The Director of Higher Education, Assam may conduct random checks of documents uploaded in
                        the portal or submitted in hard copy. Disciplinary action may be initiated against the student,
                        official or Principal/Registrar, as applicable, in case of false claim, negligence or irregularity.



               6. Fee to be Waived under the Scheme

               The fees to be waived shall include all fees that a College or University normally realises from students in
               the regular course of admission, subject to the condition that the fee shall not exceed the normal course fee
               approved/realised for the previous academic session, unless otherwise approved by the Government.

               7. Responsibility of Colleges and Universities

                   i.   All Colleges and Universities shall upload the names and details of students admitted under the Fee
                        Waiver Scheme in the Assam SAMARTH Portal or any other portal/system as notified by the
                        Directorate of Higher Education, Assam.
                  ii.   The Registrars/Principals shall ensure that all student data uploaded in the portal are correct,
                        complete and duly verified.
                 iii.   The concerned Higher Educational Institution shall maintain proper records of all students admitted
                        under the Fee Waiver Scheme, including copies of Ration Card, income certificate, declaration and
                        other relevant documents.
                 iv.    Higher Educational Institutions shall be required to collect and submit valid Aadhaar number of all
                        students admitted under the Fee Waiver Scheme process, in the format and manner to be notified
                        by the Directorate of Higher Education, Assam.
                  v.    The Higher Educational Institutions shall ensure that Aadhaar information submitted by students
                        is correct, complete and properly recorded for the purpose of verification and processing of claims
                        under the Fee Waiver Scheme.

               8. Marking at the Reverse of Marksheet of Candidate Given Free Admission

                   i.   The Universities and Colleges granting free admission under this Scheme shall give an
                        endorsement on the reverse of the relevant marksheet of the student so that the student does not
                        seek free admission in multiple Institutions.
                  ii.   The Universities and Colleges shall devise a rubber seal and use the same on the reverse of
                        marksheets of beneficiary students.
                 iii.   Where admission is processed fully through digital mode and physical endorsement on marksheet
                        is not immediately feasible, the Institution shall maintain a digital record of such endorsement and
                        ensure that duplicate benefit is not allowed.

               9. Cancellation and Recovery

                   i.   If at any stage it is found that a student has availed benefit under the Fee Waiver Scheme by
                        furnishing false information, false declaration, invalid document, ineligible Ration Card or by
                        suppressing material facts, the benefit shall be cancelled.
                  ii.   In such cases, the applicable admission fee shall be realised from the student by the concerned
                        Institution.
                 iii.   The Institution shall report such cases to the Directorate of Higher Education, Assam for further
                        necessary action.

               10. Reimbursement

                   i.   Reimbursement to the Higher Educational Institutions shall be subject to submission of correct and
                        verified beneficiary data in the prescribed portal/format.
                  ii.   Reimbursement under the Fee Waiver Scheme shall be made to the Higher Education Institutions
                        (HEIs) in respect of only those eligible students whose valid Aadhaar numbers have been submitted
                        by the institution.
                 iii.   No reimbursement shall be admissible in respect of any student whose eligibility documents are
                        found invalid or whose claim is found to be in violation of the provisions of this order.
